dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you often gather herbs here?

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: Indeed, I am quite familiar with the mountains around here, so feel free to ask if you cannot find your way.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: And I suggest staying away from Yaodie Valley unless you have a specific reason to go there. As far as I know, it is not welcoming to outsiders.
